title: Onboard Accelerator: Pulse & Role-Signal Playbook
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, experiment-oriented playbook for accelerating new hire impact and surfacing early role-signal. It blends a high-frequency pulse (first 14 days) with a role-signal heatmap and minimal interview/handoff checks to make faster, lower-friction decisions about role fit, onboarding remediation, and early coaching.

Scope:
- Applied to IC and manager hires across engineering, product, and platform teams during high-velocity hiring windows.
- Designed to run in parallel with existing 30/60/90 plans; intended to surface signals earlier without duplicating work.

Objectives (what success looks like):
1) Meaningful, documented signal from hiring -> day 14 (clear pass/monitor/action buckets).
2) Actionable remediation plan by day 21 for any monitored hires.
3) >75% of hires rated "on-track" at 30 days after applying the playbook (target for the pilot cohort).

Roles & responsibilities (quick reference):
- Hiring Manager (HM): run day 3 alignment, own role-signal review at day 14, sponsor remediation.
- Onboarding Buddy: daily async check-ins first 2 weeks, surface blockers.
- People Ops Partner: coordinate pulse survey, track signals to central dashboard.
- Tech Lead / Mentor: run practical probe and provide rubric scoring.

First 14-day cadence (pulse):
Day 0-1: welcome + environment setup checklist 
- HM confirms access to code repos, staging, docs, Slack.
- Buddy assigned and introduced in team channel.

Day 2-3: orientation + role alignment
- 30m HM shadow to review 3 concrete first-week deliverables and success criteria.
- Quick doc: "first-7 tasks" added to candidate's onboarding doc.

Day 4-6: practical probe (asynchronous or paired)
- 3 small tasks (see probe bank below). Goal: observe problem decomposition, PR hygiene, and collaboration.
- Tech lead enters scores into rubric (see rubric table).

Day 7: pulse check-in survey (2–3 questions)
- Sent by People Ops: energy, clarity of role, blockers (text field).
- Buddy flags any urgent blockers in Slack.

Day 10-14: role-signal heatmap & synthesis
- HM, Tech Lead, People Ops synthesize scores, open feedback, and early deliverable progress.
- Outcome: tag hire as PASS | MONITOR | ACTION. Add concise rationale (3 bullets).

Role-signal heatmap (example cells to be filled in with 1-5):
- Core shipping skills (domain-specific)
- Collaboration / communication
- Learning speed (ramp)
- Ownership & follow-through
- System design intuition (if applicable)
- Security / compliance awareness (if applicable)
- Cultural fit / craft values

Scoring guidance (quick):
- 5: exceeds expectations for day 14 tasks
- 3: meets minimal expectations; needs defined ramp plan
- 1: significant gaps that require remediation or role re-scope

Quick interview/probe bank (for practical probe):
- Backend engineer: fix a flaky integration test + add a lightweight test; submit PR with short description of failure root cause.
- Frontend engineer: implement small UI tweak using existing component library + accessibility checklist.
- Data engineer: build a small pipeline that ingests mock CSV and outputs aggregated metrics; include schema notes.
- Product manager: draft a 1-pager PRD for a scoped improvement and list 3 success metrics and launch risks.
- SRE / infra: triage a simulated pager (playbook provided) and author runbook notes.

Rubric snippet (fields to collect as single-line notes):
- Problem framing: 1–5
- Technical correctness: 1–5
- Test coverage / QA thinking: 1–5
- Communication clarity: 1–5
- Speed / independence: 1–5
- Notes (3 bullets): short observations 

Day 14 outcome actions (template):
- PASS -> continue standard 30/60/90; celebrate and assign stretch.
- MONITOR -> 21-day focused coaching plan with weekly checkpoints and a concrete verification exercise.
- ACTION -> consider role re-scope OR extend monitored remediation with formal HR loop; HM to escalate to People Ops within 2 business days.

Onboarding checklist (practical, copyable):
- Hardware provisioned + encrypted disk setup (yes/no)
- Primary IDE + linters pre-configured (yes/no)
- Core repo access + CI run green (yes/no)
- Team roadmap read & initial sync scheduled (yes/no)
- Buddy paired sessions scheduled (first 2 weeks) (yes/no)
- First PR opened or draft shared (yes/no)

Communication templates (short snippets for HM):
- Day 3 alignment invite: "Hey [Name], quick sync to align first-week outcomes and what success looks like for your first PR."
- Day 14 outcome note (PASS): "You moved quickly, shipped X, and showed strong ownership on Y. We'll continue with the 30/60/90 plan; next milestone is completing Z."
- Day 14 outcome note (MONITOR): "You're making progress on setup and initial tasks; we want to target [area] over the next 21 days. Please see the attached 3-step plan."

Operational notes & tooling:
- People Ops sends consolidated pulse results to a private sheet every Friday for the pilot cohort.
- Tech Leads fill the rubric in the team's shared doc (link to template in linked_artifacts).
- Use existing onboarding slack channel with standardized emoji flags: :white_check_mark: (on-track), :warning: (monitor), :x: (action).

Open questions / experiment backlog (things to A/B in pilot):
- Is a 14-day instrumented probe predictive of 90-day performance? (collect cohort data)
- Best frequency for People Ops nudges without creating overhead? (A/B weekly vs biweekly)
- Should managers be required to run a paired session in week 1? cost/benefit analysis.

Quick risks & mitigation:
- Risk: overloaded hiring managers skip synthesis -> Mitigation: People Ops flags missing reviews and auto-schedules 15m review.
- Risk: bias in early signals (e.g., different onboarding pacing) -> Mitigation: normalize scores by role and include ramp context notes.

Appendix: quick templates to copy/paste
- 21-day remediation plan (one-line template): "Goal: [clear goal]. Steps: 1) [task], 2) [task]. Measure: [artifact]. Checkpoint: [date]. Owner: [HM]."
- Day-14 synthesis prompt for HM (copy): "Please summarize: 1) 3 wins; 2) 2 blockers; 3) recommended next step (Pass / Monitor / Action) with 1 sentence rationale."

Notes to self (working):
- Pilot cohort: 15 hires across eng/product during Q4. Track longitudinal outcomes at day 30/60/90.
- Add short training for Tech Leads on rubric calibration (30m session).
- Build a small dashboard column for '14-day tag' in hiring CRM.

---
Document history: created 2025-09-02 by Aisha Patel. Drafted for pilot; please add comments inline or ping in #new-joiner-ops.
